verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents a REST API, so credential scoping is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions scoped, permission-limited or least-privilege API keys for an agent. The `fields` query parameter only controls which response fields are returned; it is not a credential scope and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
